title.narrative: TradeMark East Africa Women in trade project Kenya

description.narrative: Title ‘Enhanced participation of Women in Trade in Kenya’ (WIT) . The WIT Project is implemented by Trade Mark East Africa (TMEA) . TMEA implements the programme through a consortium of 3 partners namely : Partner Africa, TruTrade and Sauti East Africa.Project overall goal is to increase number of women participating in trade within the agricultural sector in Kenya through eliminating the barriers of entry to trade for women and building the capacity of female producers, aggregators, cross-border traders, women-owned or women-led MSMEs/SMEs. Project activities include: 1.Strengthening access to agri-markets for female aggregators/producers 2. Increase participation of women traders in select sectors 3. Enhance capacity in women owned/women led SMEs/MSMEs 4. Improve the policy/regulatory environment for women in trade
